_description: Search DTW McNamara gate operations by concourse, status, flight ident, origin, or destination.

airport.description: Airport IATA code. Only DTW is supported.

concourse.description: Concourse letter: A, B, or C.

flightIdent.description: Flight ident substring such as DL1234.

origin.description: Origin IATA code such as ATL.

destination.description: Destination IATA code such as LAX.

delayedOnly.description: If true, return only gates with a delay.

limit.description: Maximum number of gates to return (1-200).
